coverage_note: The design names 67 existing kinds and about 250 future grammar-derived items but does not enumerate that future catalog. This report covers all current kinds, the 30 named mechanism/signal parts, and the concrete additional objects/materials named in the design. Generic tools, weapons, containers, hoards, piles, plots and construction states require composition/overlays rather than an invented list of 250 hero requests.
